baselineSource.result: V1 remains the frozen verified reference for browser collection and integrity behavior.

sqlExecutionScheduler.result: Selected immutable query versions, parser-level read-only analytical gate, fixed cadence anchored to activation, no-overlap with missed-tick coalescing, successful-cycle commit priority, streamed result accounting and distinct latest-execution/latest-success semantics.
sqlExecutionScheduler.safety: Authoritative DB remains READ_WRITE for ingest; analytical safety uses statement classification plus DuckDB external-access/extension/configuration hardening where verified in pinned Wasm.
sqlExecutionScheduler.cancellation: Hard cancellation remains unverified for public DuckDB-Wasm API; baseline uses observability/no-overlap and requires performance headroom rather than pretending timeout interruption exists.
